_comment: Copy to D:\Dekirai\Servers\DW4Online\config\appsettings.Production.json (outside the app folder, readable only by Administrators, SYSTEM and NT SERVICE\DW4Online). It holds secrets: never commit it.
_comment_kestrel: Https: the public endpoint. If another program holds port 443 (Traefik, IIS, Apache), use another port, for example https://0.0.0.0:8443, with install-service.ps1 -HttpsPort 8443 (DEPLOY.md section 4.1). Http: appsettings.json's plain endpoint stays active below this file; it listens on the loopback address only (checks on the server: curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:5280/health). Give it another free 127.0.0.1 port if 5280 is taken (DEPLOY.md section 4).
_comment_tls: IP phase: the self-signed certificate of deploy/new-selfsigned-cert.ps1 for the IP address (the client pins it). Later add the domain to AdditionalHostNames and set Service:PathBase (DEPLOY.md section 6).
_comment_database: User ID=dw4online with its own password (DEPLOY.md section 2), or User ID=root with the root password in the root-only variant (section 2.1). Port: the database's port (3306, or 3307 next to another MySQL). AutoMigrate: the service applies pending migrations at its start too; run 'DW4Online.Server.exe migrate' in a console first anyway (DEPLOY.md, Migrations).
_comment_service: PathBase: the path below which the website and the API live, e.g. /dw4online (DEPLOY.md section 6.2). BehindProxy: true when a reverse proxy on this server (Traefik, IIS) forwards the website to http://127.0.0.1:5280; X-Forwarded-For / -Proto then count, from plain-HTTP connections of this machine only, and a stripping proxy's X-Forwarded-Prefix when it is PathBase (set PathBase with and without stripPrefix). TrustedProxyNetworks: with BehindProxy, Cloudflare's published ranges (https://www.cloudflare.com/ips/): when the proxy saw one of them, Cloudflare's CF-Connecting-IP is the browser's address, so per-IP limits see the browser and not the edge. Traefik stays at its default (no forwardedHeaders.trustedIPs). DEPLOY.md section 6.2, case 2, has the whole list.
_comment_web: Operator*: the controller on the privacy page. Processors: service providers the privacy page names beside the hosting provider, one text each; with Cloudflare in front of the website (DEPLOY.md section 6.2, case 2) its entry from there.
_comment_play: Play:MinimumProtocol: the code refuses anything below the world's protocol 50 whatever this says (DEPLOY.md section 9.3, SEAMLESS 19.22 step 7): 50.
_comment_world: The online world (DEPLOY.md section 10): DataHashes / RankedDataHashes empty = any game data is admitted and ranked; the history is kept HistoryDays.
